summary: 23/31 requirements pass. The single root failure is the infrastructure module's DETAIL.md using ### (3-hash) section headers instead of the required #### (4-hash), causing Appendix G to detect 0/52 complete file blocks for that module. This cascades to fail R5, R5b, P3, S2, S5. The fix is surgical: update infrastructure/DETAIL.md headers (### → ####), which immediately resolves all five failures. A secondary issue is V1: INDEX.md ## headings use module_id names (e.g., '## Scrapydocs', '## Testing-Conftest') instead of functional descriptions; the bold text within each section IS functional, but the ## headings visible in TOC/navigation are not. Both failures are agent errors, not Skill documentation defects — the Skill docs clearly specify #### headers and heading renaming requirements.
